branding.title: ReadmePort
branding.tagline: One config. Beautiful READMEs for every forge.

owner.name: Yunus Çoğal
owner.bio: Building portable tools for polished project, profile, and organization READMEs.

about: ReadmePort turns one human-editable JSON configuration into polished, provider-aware Markdown. Use the CLI for repeatable builds or the local Studio for visual editing, previews, and downloads.

features.title: Forge aware
features.description: Build for GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo, Bitbucket, or portable Markdown.

features.title: Easy to edit
features.description: Change one documented JSON file, use the Studio, or eject any template.

features.title: Safe regeneration
features.description: Keep hand-written notes inside named manual regions across rebuilds.

stack.name: Markdown
stack.detail: Provider-aware output with a portable fallback

installation.title: Create a configuration
installation.description: Generate a starter for a project, personal profile, or organization.

installation.title: Preview in Studio
installation.description: Open the local editor without sending configuration data to a hosted service.

usage.title: Generate every provider variant
usage.description: Write reviewable outputs into a staging directory before publishing the one you want.
